events.title: Emperor Didius Julianus is killed as Severus nears Rome
events.description: Abandoned by the Senate and the Praetorian Guard, Didius Julianus was killed in the palace after a reign of 66 days. Septimius Severus entered Rome soon afterwards and founded a new dynasty.
events.html: Abandoned by the Senate and the Praetorian Guard, Didius Julianus was killed in the palace after a reign of 66 days. Septimius Severus entered Rome soon afterwards and founded a new dynasty.

events.title: Scottish exchequer records malt for 'aqua vitae'
events.description: An entry in the Exchequer Rolls records malt given to Friar John Cor 'to make aqua vitae' for King James IV. It is the earliest known written reference to whisky distilling in Scotland.
events.html: An entry in the Exchequer Rolls records malt given to Friar John Cor 'to make aqua vitae' for King James IV. It is the earliest known written reference to whisky distilling in Scotland.

events.title: Anne Boleyn is crowned Queen of England
events.description: Six months pregnant with the future Elizabeth I, Anne Boleyn was crowned in Westminster Abbey. Her marriage to Henry VIII had required England's break with the papacy.
events.html: Six months pregnant with the future Elizabeth I, Anne Boleyn was crowned in Westminster Abbey. Her marriage to Henry VIII had required England's break with the papacy.

events.title: Howe defeats the French fleet on the Glorious First of June
events.description: Lord Howe's Channel Fleet captured six French ships of the line far out in the Atlantic. Yet the grain convoy the French were protecting reached France safely.
events.html: Lord Howe's Channel Fleet captured six French ships of the line far out in the Atlantic. Yet the grain convoy the French were protecting reached France safely.

events.title: Tennessee becomes the 16th US state
events.description: Tennessee was the first state created from a federal territory, the Territory South of the River Ohio. It later produced three presidents: Andrew Jackson, James Polk and Andrew Johnson.
events.html: Tennessee was the first state created from a federal territory, the Territory South of the River Ohio. It later produced three presidents: Andrew Jackson, James Polk and Andrew Johnson.

events.title: Madison asks Congress for war with Britain
events.description: President Madison's message cited the impressment of American sailors and British restrictions on neutral trade. Congress declared war on 18 June, beginning the War of 1812.
events.html: President Madison's message cited the impressment of American sailors and British restrictions on neutral trade. Congress declared war on 18 June, beginning the War of 1812.

events.title: HMS Shannon captures USS Chesapeake off Boston
events.description: In a fight lasting about fifteen minutes, HMS Shannon took the American frigate Chesapeake. The dying American captain James Lawrence's words, 'Don't give up the ship', became a US Navy motto.
events.html: In a fight lasting about fifteen minutes, HMS Shannon took the American frigate Chesapeake. The dying American captain James Lawrence's words, 'Don't give up the ship', became a US Navy motto.

events.title: CNN launches as the first 24-hour news channel
events.description: Ted Turner's Cable News Network began broadcasting from Atlanta. Its round-the-clock coverage created the modern continuous news cycle.
events.html: Ted Turner's Cable News Network began broadcasting from Atlanta. Its round-the-clock coverage created the modern continuous news cycle.
